name: io.github.devaimani/chatgpt-ads-mcp
title: ChatGPT Ads
description: Manage OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT Ads) campaigns, ad groups, ads and reporting. Retries the API's sporadic 409, bounds oversized insights responses, and resolves postcode-level locations the docs do not document.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from the OpenAI Ads Manager at ads.openai.com, under Settings. One key covers exactly one ad account.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register no write tools at all. Recommended for a first look at an account that already has live campaigns.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
environmentVariables.description: Campaign budgets above this value require an explicit confirmation flag before they are created.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Account currency, used when explaining micros conversions.
